description:
What if every man on Earth disappeared overnight… except you?

Four billion women. One ordinary guy. And suddenly, humanity’s future depends on him.

In this animated what-if story, an ordinary night turns into global chaos, unexpected fame, and the hardest job in human history. Being the last man on Earth might sound like a dream—but reality gets complicated fast.

Could one man help humanity survive? And what would his life actually look like?

What would YOU do first? Tell us in the comments.

Subscribe to Awaken for more stories that make you think.

#WhatIf #LastManOnEarth #Awaken
